messages:
emma.k: quick PSA — cutoff is in ~3 hours. please drop your one-liners for the release notes if you haven't yet. short + component tag please. :alarm_clock:

Tomas: on it. do we still prefer the three-part shape? (component — summary — impact)

emma.k: yep, that shape. examples below — paste your one-liner and the PR link.

jen: here are two quick examples I used earlier: 
```
(service/runtime) reduce kv-cache flush frequency to improve tail latency — small latency improvement for long-running chat sessions
(optimizer) add quantized cast for linear kernels — lowers memory by ~15% for t4-like setups
```
I keep them compact and avoid implementation details.

alex_r: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/4321 — added the batching knob docs. One-liner: (console) surface batching config in UI — lets customers tune per-model batching from the console

Tomas: pinging owners of backports: @jen @alex_r — if you want these in the release, please mark the PR with `release/accept` label. otherwise they get rolled to the next cycle.

emma.k: small lint check: entries must be <= 140 char ideally, include parens component prefix, no imperative verbs asking people to do stuff (e.g., don't say "please"), and include a PR link in the thread.

release-bot: rule-check: entry-format OK for PR 4321. label-check FAILED for PR 4319 (missing release/accept). See https://go/release-guides/changelog-format

jen: I pushed a squashed one for PR 4319: (infra) add cutoff signal to deploy bot — adds a path for graceful rollbacks ; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/4319

emma.k: thanks. last thing — if your change requires a major-version bump, call it out explicitly in the one-liner and in the PR title so release engineers can flag for semver. otherwise we'll assume patch/minor.

alex_r: quick Q — if we backport a change to release branch, do we add both PRs in the same one-liner or two separate lines?

emma.k: add both PRs if they're the same logical change (e.g., backport + main) in one line, like: `(runtime) fix mem leak — backported PRs #4401,#4402` otherwise separate lines.

Tomas: short heads-up: branch queue is heavy atm. if your PR is >300 LOC please move to canary label and ping me. I can reprioritize CI.

jen: noted. will keep example one-liner below 140 chars.

emma.k: perfect. I'll assemble notes at T-45m and ping for final sign-off. thanks all :rocket:
